content:
Elena: Hey team 44b Im in Prague next week for a few days (based in Vinohrady). Craving good svickova, goulash, and where to find proper trdelniks that aren’t tourist traps. Any recs? Also coffee spots that are laptop-friendly?

Vik: For authentic Czech food try 'Lokl' (several spots). Great goulash and beer selection. Not far from Vinohrady.

Pavel: If you want svickova, 'U Maliru' in the Old Town has a classic take. It's sit-down and a bit formal, but the sauce is legit.

June: For trdelniks avoid the ones by the Charles Bridge at noon 605 those are always crowded and meh. Go to 'Cukrkandl' in Vinohrady for fresher pastries and trdelnik-style rolls without the tourist circus.

Marco: Coffee + laptop: 'EMA espresso bar' is small but chill with good wifi; 'MujSalek' in Vinohrady has big tables on weekdays. Avoid places that ask you to buy only a pastry to sit during peak hours.

Elena: Any vegetarian-friendly traditional dishes? My partner is veggie.

Vik: Try 'smazeny syr' (fried cheese) — classic and vegetarian. Many pubs will do it. Also 'kulajda' (mushroom dill soup) is often meat-free if you check.

Pavel: Also, 'Moment Cafe' near Namesti Miru has whole grain sandwiches and accepts laptops. And if you want non-touristy beer gardens, 'Riegrovy Sady' has a picnic vibe with a view of the city.

June: Pasteable map list:
```
Lokl  Dlouha / multiple locations (Old Town & Karlin)
U Maliru  Tynska 6, Old Town
Cukrkandl  Korunne1 24, Vinohrady
EMA espresso bar  Dittrichova 8, New Town
Moment Cafe  Ne1m1bsted Medra 1 (near Namesti Miru)
Riegrovy Sady beer garden  Riegrovo namesti, Vinohrady
```

Marco: Quick logistical tip: many restaurants take cash only for small items; have some koruna on hand. Also dinner reservations Friday nights recommended for Lokl and U Maliru.

Elena: Love it 60a Any late-night pastry recs for a 1am sweet craving?

June: 'Angelato' does late gelato in some seasons; otherwise some bakeries near the station stay open late on weekends. If you're up late, try the night tram and stop by Letna for skyline views and street vendors in summer.

Vik: Want to do a mini-crawl Sat evening? Goulash -> beer garden -> trdelnik?

lunchbot: Poll created "Prague food crawl Sat evening?" Options: 1) Yes 2) No 3) Maybe. Vote with :one:/:two:/:three:.

Elena: If poll says yes I can block an hour after 7pm. Thanks all 60a
